name: Absolutely Haunting
source:
"Absolutely Haunting" is a shorter eroge visual novel about your school's Occult Club, which only has three members.

Gabrielle, Lucy, and you decide to liven up your club activities, and investigate the rumors about the abandoned old school.

As you start your ghost hunt, the doors slam shut behind you and you discover you're locked in! The haunting rumors of this place may not be rumors at all. Figure out who or what is haunting the school, why Gabby and Lucy are acting so enjoyably strange, and get out without becoming the next ghost!

[From [url=https://mindshardstudios.itch.io/absolutely-haunting-chapter-one-public-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《绝对鬼魂》是一部较短的工口游戏视觉小说，讲述的是你们学校的神秘俱乐部，该俱乐部只有三名成员。

加布里埃尔、露西和你们决定活跃你们的俱乐部活动，并调查有关废弃旧学校的谣言。

当你开始寻找幽灵时，门在你身后砰地关上，你发现自己被锁在里面了！关于此地的那些萦绕心头的传闻，或许根本就不是传闻。找出谁或什么东西在学校里出没，为什么加比和露西表现得如此奇怪，然后离开，不要成为下一个鬼魂！

[来自[url=https://mindshardstudios.itch.io/absolutely-haunting-chapter-one-public-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
